लक्षण: लक्षण, अम्, n. a mark, distinctive mark, sign, symbol, token, indication, characteristic (often at the end of comps., e. g. पुरुष-ल्°, the mark or organ of virility; at the end of adj. comps. the fem. is in आ and rarely in ई); character, attribute, quality; stroke, line, spot; a lucky mark, favourable sign; a symptom or indication of disease; an accurate mark, accurate description, definition; settled rate, fixed tariff (Manu VIII. 406); a designation, appel-lation, name, (sometimes at the end of comps., e. g. ऋग्-यजुः-साम-लक्षण, named Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma); aiming at, aim, intention, scope, object, signification; form, kind; subject, head, term, pro-vince; effect, operation influence; cause, occasion; observation, sight, seeing; (अस्), m. the Indian crane, Ardea Sibirica; a proper N.; = लक्ष्मण, the brother of Rāma; (आ), f. aim, object, view; an indirect indication or hint, elliptical mode of expres-sion, ellipsis, a word or phrase understood though not expressed, metonymy; (Pāṇ. IV. 1, 70).

लक्षणिन्: लक्षणिन्, ई, इनी, इ, possessing marks, &c.; = लक्षण-ज्ञ, q. v.
लक्षणीय: लक्षणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be perceived or re-garded as, perceptible, to be expressed by ellipsis, expressible by metonymy.
लक्षण्य: लक्षण्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. लक्षण), serving as a mark or token, having good marks or signs.
लक्षयत्: लक्षयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, marking, observing, perceiving.
लक्षयित्वा: लक्षयित्वा, ind. having perceived or observed, having noticed.
लक्षित: लक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, marked, denoted, character-ized; characterized or recognisable by; defined; expressed (indirectly), hinted at; aimed at; re-marked, observed, perceived, discerned, discovered, beheld, seen, evident; considered, regarded; enquired into, examined. —लक्षित-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being marked or expressed indirectly. —लक्षित-लक्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, having the marks (of any-thing) perceived or evident.
लक्षितव्य: लक्षितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be marked or defined.
लक्षिन्: लक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having good marks or signs.
लक्ष्म: लक्ष्म = लक्ष्मन् at the end of an adj. comp.
लक्ष्मक: लक्ष्मक, अस्, m. a proper N.
लक्ष्मण: लक्ष्मण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. लक्ष्मन्), having marks or signs, furnished with tokens or character-istics; possessed of lucky signs or marks, lucky, fortunate, prosperous, thriving; (अस्), m. the Indian crane, Ardea Sibirica; N. of a Vāsiṣṭha; of a son of Daśa-ratha by his wife Su-mitrā, (he was younger brother and companion of Rāma during his travels and adventures; Lakṣmaṇa and Śatru-ghna were both sons of Su-mitrā, but Lakṣmaṇa alone is usually called Saumitri; he so attached himself to Rāma as to be called Rāma's second self; whereas Śatru-ghna attached himself to Bharata); N. of various other persons; (आ), f. the female of the Ardea Sibirica; a goose; N. of various plants (= ओषधि, पृश्नि-पर्णी, पुत्र-कन्दा, श्वेत-कण्टकारी); N. of a wife of Kṛṣṇa; of a daughter of Duryo-dhana (carried off by Śāmba, son of Kṛṣṇa); of an Apsaras; of the mother of the eighth Arhat of the present Avasarpiṇī; (अम्), n. = लक्षण, a mark, sign, token, spot; a name. —लक्ष्मण-कवच, अम्, n., N. of a hymn in praise of Lakṣ-maṇa. —लक्ष्मण-कुण्डक, अम्, n., N. of a place. —लक्ष्मण-खण्ड-प्रशस्ति, इस्, f., N. of a work. —लक्ष्मण-चन्द्र, अस्, m., N. of a king. —लक्ष्मण-देव, अस्, m. a proper N. —लक्ष्-मण-प्रसू, ऊस्, f. the mother of Lakṣmaṇa, i. e. लक्ष्य: लक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be marked, to be defined or described; having marks or attributes, to be ex-pressed indirectly; to be aimed at; to be regarded as, deserving to be regarded; to be looked at or observed, observable, perceptible, visible; to be re-cognised or known, recognisable by (with inst. or at the end of a comp.); (अस्), m. epithet of a magical formula or charm recited over weapons; (अम्), n. an aim, object, mark to be aimed at, butt, target, prize; a lac or one hundred thousand; mere appear-ance, sham, pretence [cf. लक्ष्य-सुप्त]; a sign, token (for लक्ष्मन्); an example, illustration (?). —लक्ष्य-क्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, having an indirectly perceptible method (said of that which is suggested by poetry but not expressed). —लक्ष्य-ज्ञ-त्व, अम्, n. knowledge of a mark or aim; knowledge of examples. —लक्ष्य-ता, f. or लक्ष्य-त्व, अम्, n. the being indirectly expressed; the being an aim or object, (लक्ष्यतां या, to become an aim or object); perceptibility, visibility, (लक्ष्-यतां नी, to make visible.) —लक्ष्य-भेद, अस्, m. the cleaving of a mark. —लक्ष्य-वीथी, f. the visible or universally recognisable road, (ac-cording to a commentator = ब्रह्म-लोक-मार्ग।) —लक्ष्य-वेधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, piercing or hitting a mark. —लक्ष्य-सुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, pretending to be asleep, shamming sleep. —लक्ष्य-हन्, हा, घ्नी, ह, hitting the mark; (हा), m. an arrow. —लक्ष्याभिहरण (°य-अभ्°), अम्, n. the carry-ing off of a prize. —लक्ष्यी-कृ, लक्ष्यी-कृत, = लक्-षी-कृ, लक्षी-कृत, see under लक्ष. —लक्ष्यी-भू = लक्षी-भू।

लप्सुद: लप्सुद लप्सुद, अम्, n., Ved. = कूर्च, the beard (of a goat &c.).
लप्सुदिन्: लप्सुदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. having a beard, bearded (said of a goat &c.).
लब: लब लब, अस्, m., Ved. a quail [cf. लव]; N. of the author of the hymn Ṛg-veda X. 119, (his patronymic is Aindra.) —लब-सूक्त, अम्, n., N. of the hymn Ṛg-veda X. 119.
लब्ध: लब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, taken, seized, taken hold of, obtained, received, got, gained, won, acquired; per-ceived, apprehended, known, obtained (as a quotient by division &c.; cf. लब्धि); (आ), f. a woman whose husband or lover is faithless; epithet of a particular heroine. —लब्ध-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has gained his wishes. —लब्ध-कीर्त्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, one who has won fame or glory. —लब्ध-चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, one who has recovered his right mind, restored to sense, recovered. —लब्ध-जन्मन्, आ, आ, अ, one who has obtained birth, born. —लब्ध-दत्त, अस्, m. ‘restoring what one has received,’ a proper N. —लब्ध-धन, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has acquired wealth, wealthy. —लब्ध-नामन्, आ, आ, अ, one who has gained a name, well spoken of, famous, celebrated. —लब्ध-नाश, अस्, m. the loss of what has been acquired. —लब्ध-प्रणाश, अस्, m. the loss of anything acquired; N. of the fourth book of the Pañca-tantra. —लब्ध-प्रतिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has acquired fame or renown. —लब्ध-प्रशमन, अम्, n. the securing of what has been acquired, keeping acquisitions in safety; (according to Kullūka on Manu VII. 56) bestowing acquisitions on a proper recipient. —लब्-धप्रशमन-स्वस्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, at ease by (reason of) the securing or secure possession of acquisitions. —लब्ध-लक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has hit the mark, one who has obtained the prize; skilled in the use of missiles; (अस्), m. a proper N. —लब्ध-लक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = लब्ध-लक्ष। —लब्ध-वर, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has obtained a boon or favour; (अस्), m. a proper N. —लब्ध-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has learnt his letters, lettered, learned, sage, skilful, clever. —लब्धवर्-ण-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, honouring the learned. —लब्ध-विद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has acquired knowledge or wisdom, learned, educated. —लब्ध-शब्द, अस्, आ, अम्, = लब्ध-नामन्. —लब्ध-सञ्ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has recovered his senses, restored to consciousness. —लब्ध-सिद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, one who has attained perfection. —लब्धानुज्ञ (°ध-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has obtained leave of absence. —लब्धान्तर (°ध-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has found an opportunity. —लब्धावकाश (°ध-अव्°) or लब्धावसर (°ध-अव्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has found an opportunity or gained scope, one who has obtained leisure. —लब्धोदय (°ध-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has received birth or production (Kumāra-s. I. 25); one who has attained prosperity, prosperous.
लभ्: लभ् लभ् (probably a later form of rt. रभ्), cl. 1. A. लभते (ep. also P. ल-भति; a nasal is also sometimes inserted, e. g. लम्भते, अलम्भत, as if fr. a rt. लम्भ्), लेभे, लप्स्यते, अलब्ध, लब्धुम्, to take, seize, take hold of, catch, catch hold of; to receive, (गर्भं लभ्, to receive an embryo, conceive, become preg-nant), obtain, get, acquire, enjoy; to meet with, find, gain possession of, have, possess; to recover, regain; to gain the power of doing anything, be able, be permitted (with infinitive, e. g. लभते द्रष्टुम्, he is able or is allowed to see); to per-ceive, know, understand, learn: Pass. लभ्यते, Aor. अलाभि or अलम्भि (with prep. only अलम्भि), to be taken or received, to be gained or obtained, &c.; to be found; to be contained; to take (Passive reflexive): Caus. लम्भयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अल-लम्भत्, to cause to take or receive, cause to obtain, &c. (generally with a double acc.; rarely with acc. and inst.); to give, bestow; to obtain, receive; to find out, discover; to cause to suffer: Desid. लिप्सते (sometimes P. when required by the metre; Ved. also लीप्सते), to wish to seize or take hold of, to strive to obtain, desire to receive or obtain, long for: Intens. लालभ्यते, लालम्भीति, लालब्धि; [cf. Gr. λάφυρον, λαμβάνω, εἴληφα, λαῖλαψ, probably λέβης, λίπτω: Old Pruss. labba-s, ‘goods, posses-sions;’ lab-s, ‘good:’ Lith. laba-s, ‘good,’ lobis, ‘possessions, goods:’ Slav. lov-i-ti: Hib. lamh, ‘a hand.’]
लब्धक: लब्धक, अस्, इका, अम्, obtained, received, got, attained; [cf. दुःख-लब्धिका।]
लब्धवत्: लब्धवत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has obtained or gained or received.
लब्धव्य: लब्धव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be obtained or received, to be gained or attained, obtainable, &c. See लभ्य।
लब्धि: लब्धि, इस्, f. obtaining, gaining, acquisition, acquirement, attainment; anything gained or ob-tained, gain, advantage, profit; the quotient (in arithmetic).
लब्धृ: लब्धृ, धा, ध्री, धृ, one who obtains or receives, a receiver, gainer, recipient.
लब्ध्रिम: लब्ध्रिम, अस्, आ, अम्, obtained, received, attained.
लब्ध्वा: लब्ध्वा, ind. having obtained or gained, having got.
लभ: लभ in इषल्-ल्°, दुर्-ल्°, q. q. v. v.
लभन: लभन, अम्, n. the act of obtaining or getting, the meeting with, gaining possession of; the act of conceiving, conception.
लभस: लभस, अस्, m. a horse's foot-rope, a rope for tying a horse (= वाजि-बन्धन); wealth, riches; one who asks or solicits, a solicitor.
लभ्य: लभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be found or met with, capable of being acquired, acquirable, obtainable, attainable, procurable, to be reached (see प्रांशु-ल्°); to be understood or known, intelligible; suitable, proper, fit; to be furnished or provided with.
लभ्यमान: लभ्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being obtained, being acquired. &c.
लम्भ: लम्भ, अस्, m. the obtaining or attaining, attain-ment, acquirement; finding, meeting with, recovery; gain; (आ), f. a sort of fence or enclosure.
लम्भक: लम्भक, अस्, m. one who obtains, an obtainer, one who finds, a finder.
लम्भन: लम्भन, अम्, n. the act of obtaining or re-ceiving, attainment, recovery; the act of procuring, causing to get; abuse, reviling (?).
लम्भनीय: लम्भनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be obtained or re-ceived, to be attained, attainable.
लम्भम्: लम्भम्, ind. having taken or obtained, (लम्-भं लम्भम् repeatedly taking, &c.)
लम्भयत्: लम्भयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to obtain, procuring, producing.
लम्भित: लम्भित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), caused to obtain or receive, given, procured, gained; height-ened, improved; cherished; applied, employed, adapted; addressed, spoken to; abused (?). —लम्-भित-कान्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, one who has acquired lustre or beauty.
लम्भुक: लम्भुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one who is accus-tomed to receive.
लाभ: लाभ, अस्, m. obtaining, receiving, gaining, get-ting, meeting with, finding, acquirement, acquisition; gain, advantage, profit; capture, conquest; appre-hension, comprehension, perception, knowledge; en-joying; = प्राप्ति, N. of the eleventh astrological house or lunar mansion; [cf. Slav. lovu.] —लाभ-कर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, or लाभ-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, causing gain, making or procuring profit, gainful, profitable. —लाभ-लिप्सा, f. greediness of gain, avarice, covet-ousness. —लाभ-लिप्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of gain or profit, covetous, grasping. —लाभ-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having gain or profit; being in possession of. —लाभालाभ (°भ-अल्°), औ, m. du. profit and loss, advantage and disadvantage, gain and detriment.
लाभक: लाभक, अस्, m. gain, profit, advantage.
लाभिन्: लाभिन्, ई, इनी, इ, obtaining, gaining, meeting with, finding, receiving, acquiring.
लाभ्य: लाभ्य, अम्, n. = लाभ (according to some).
लिप्सा: लिप्सा, f. (fr. the Desid.), the desire to gain, wish to acquire or obtain, desire for possessing.
लिप्सा लिप्सा, लिप्सु, लिप्स्य, &c. See p. 862, col. 1.
लिप्सित: लिप्सित, अस्, आ, अम्, wished to be obtained, coveted, desired.
लिप्सितव्य: लिप्सितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, desirable to be obtained, to be wished for.
लिप्सु: लिप्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to gain or obtain, de-siring to become possessed of (with acc.), eager for, desirous of, covetous. —लिप्सु-ता, f. the state of wishing to obtain, covetousness.
लिप्स्य: लिप्स्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be wished to be obtained, desirable to be acquired, eligible.
लीप्सितव्य: लीप्सितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. worthy of being acquired, desirable.
लम्: लम् लम् (a later form of rt. रम्), cl. 1. P. लमति (= रमति), ललाम (= रराम), &c., to delight in, sport, enjoy (sexually).
लमक: लमक, अस्, m. = रमक, a lover, wooer, para-mour, (according to Ujjvala-datta, Uṇādi-s. II. 33, = तीर्थ-शोधक); a proper N.
लम्न: लम्न लम्न, आस्, m. pl., N. of a particular tribe.
लम्पक: लम्पक लम्पक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a Jaina sect.
लम्पट: लम्पट लम्पट, अस्, आ, अम् (perhaps con-nected with rt. लप्; cf. लिम्पट), covetous, greedy, desirous, lustful; hankering after, addicted to (licen-tious pleasures), lascivious, dissolute; (अस्), m. a libertine, lecher, dissolute person. —लम्पट-ता, f. or लम्पट-त्व, अम्, n. eagerness, greediness; liber-tinism, lasciviousness, dissoluteness, lewdness.
लम्पाक: लम्पाक, अस्, आ, अम्, = लम्पट; (अस्), m., N. of a country (= मुरण्ड; according to some the district of Lamghan in Cabul).
लम्पा: लम्पा लम्पा, f., N. of a town; of a king-dom. —लम्पा-पटह, अस्, m. a kind of drum (= प्रतिपत्ति-पटह, टट्टरी).
लम्फ: लम्फ लम्फ, अस्, m. a leap, spring, jump; [cf. झम्प।]
लम्फन: लम्फन, अम्, n. leaping, springing, jumping, (a form उल्-लम्फन, ‘jumping up,’ is given.)
लम्ब्: लम्ब् लम्ब् (a later form of rt. रम्ब्), cl. 1. A. लम्बते (sometimes also P. लम्-बति), ललम्बे, लम्बिष्यते, अलम्बिष्ट, लम्-बितुम्, to hang down, depend, dangle, hang from, hang on or upon, depend on or from; to sink, sink down, go down, decline, fall, set (as the sun); to be fastened to, be attached to, hold on to, rest on; to fall behind, stay behind, lag behind, be retarded; to delay, tarry; to sound (fr. rt. रम्ब्; cf. rt. लम्भ्): Caus. लम्बयति, &c., to cause to hang down or depend, let down; to hang up, suspend; to cause to be fastened or attached, join; to stretch out, extend; to depress, (perhaps) discourage; [cf. Lat. labi; Lith. rambus; Angl. Sax. limpian, ge-limp; Eng. limp.]
लम्ब: लम्ब, अस्, आ, अम्, hanging down, depending, pendulous, pendent, dangling; hanging on or upon, attached to; long, tall; expanded, great, large; spacious, capacious; (अस्), m. a perpendicular (in geometry); complement of latitude, co-latitude (in astronomy), the arc between the pole of any place and the zenith; epithet of a particular throw or move (at a kind of chess or a game like backgam-mon or draughts); N. of a Muni; of a Daitya; a present, bribe (?) , = नर्तक, अङ्ग, कान्त; (आ), f. a kind of bitter gourd or cucumber; N. of one of the Mātṛs attending upon Skanda; N. of Durgā or Gaurī; of Lakṣmī; of a daughter of Dakṣa and wife of Dharma or Manu; of a Rākṣasī. —लम्ब-कर्ण, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, having pendulous ears, long-eared; (अस्), m. a he-goat, goat; an elephant; a hawk, falcon; a Rākṣasa; Alangium Hexapetalum; N. of one of Śiva's attendants; of an ass (in one of the stories of the Pañca-tantra); of a hare (in the Pañca-tantra). —लम्ब-केश, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, hav-ing hanging or flowing hair. —लम्ब-केशक, अस्, m. ‘long-haired,’ N. of a Muni. —लम्ब-गुण, अस्, m. the sine of the co-latitude (in astronomy). —लम्ब-जठर, अस्, आ, अम्, big-bellied. —लम्-ब-जिह्व, अस्, आ, अम्, letting the tongue hang out; (अस्), m., N. of a Rākṣasa. —लम्ब-ज्या or लम्ब-ज्यका, f. the sine of the co-latitude (in astronomy). —लम्ब-दन्ता, f. a kind of plant (= सैंहली)। —लम्ब-पयोधरा, f. a woman with large or pendent breasts; N. of one of the Mātṛs attending upon Skanda. —लम्ब-रेखा, f. the complement of latitude, co-latitude (in astronomy). —लम्ब-वीजा, f. = लम्ब-दन्ता. —लम्ब-स्फिच्, क्, क्, क्, having large or protuberant buttocks. —लम्बाक्ष (°ब-अक्°), अस्, m., N. of a Muni. —लम्बालक (°ब-अल्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having pendulous curls or ringlets. —लम्बालक-त्व, अम्, n. pendulosity of ringlets. —लम्बोदर (°ब-उद्°), अस्, ई, अम्, having a large or protuberant belly, pot-bellied; (अस्), m. a voracious person, glutton; N. of Gaṇeśa; of a king; of a Muni; (ई), f., N. of a female demon. —लम्-बोष्ठ (°ब-ओष्°), अस्, आ or ई, अम्, having a large or prominent under-lip; (अस्), m. a camel, (also written लम्बौष्ठ।)
लम्बक: लम्बक, अस्, m. a perpendicular (in geometry); the complement of latitude, co-latitude (in astro-nomy); N. of a particular implement or vessel; N. of the fifteenth astronomical Yoga; N. of the larger sections or books of the Kathā-sarit-sāgara (of which there are eighteen, containing in all 124 Taraṅgas or chapters); (इका), f. the uvula or soft palate. —लम्बिका-कोकिला, f., N. of a deity.
लम्बन: लम्बन, अस्, आ, अम्, hanging down, depending, pendulous; causing to hang down; (अस्), m., N. of Śiva; phlegm, the phlegmatic humor; (अम्), n. hanging down, depending, descending, falling; fringe; a long necklace (depending from the neck to the navel); the parallax in longitude (of the moon), the interval of the lines between the earth's centre and surface; epithet of a particular mode of fighting; N. of a Varṣa in Kuśa-dvīpa. —लम्बन-विधि, इस्, m. the rule for calculating the above parallax (in astronomy).
लम्बमान: लम्बमान, अस्, आ, अम्, hanging down, depend-ing, descending, dangling, falling, going down; being large or bulky.
लम्बिका: लम्बिका, f. See under लम्बक above.
लम्बित: लम्बित, अस्, आ, अम्, hanging down, pendent; suspended; sunk, gone down, set; laying hold of, attached to, supported or resting on; = वि-लम्बित, slow (of time in music).
लम्बिन्: लम्बिन्, ई, इनी, इ, hanging down, depending, pen-dent, hanging down as far as, hanging on or upon; (इनी), f. one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda.
लम्बुक: लम्बुक, अस्, m., N. of a serpent-demon; N. of the fifteenth astronomical Yoga, (for लम्बक।)
लम्बुषा: लम्बुषा, f. a necklace of seven strings.
लम्भ्: लम्भ् लम्भ् (= rt. रम्भ्), cl. 1. A. लम्भते, &c., to sound.
लय्: लय् लय् (= rt. रय्), cl. 1. A. लयते, &c., to go.
लय: लय लय, लयन, &c. See p. 868, cols. 2, 3.

लय, अस्, m. the act of clinging, adhering, stick-ing, union, adherence; embracing, an embrace (= श्लेष, सं-श्लेषण); the act of lying, cowering, lurking, hiding; melting, fusion, solution, melting away, dissolution, absorption, extinction, disappearing, vanishing, disappearance, destruction, reduction (of the Universe &c.) into its original state, death, (लयं या or गम्, &c., to go to dissolution, melt away, disappear, vanish; to be destroyed, perish); rest, repose; place of rest, residence, house, dwelling; mental inactivity, spiritual indifference, slackness of mind; time (in music, regarded as of three kinds, viz. द्रुत, ‘quick,’ मध्य, ‘mean or moderate,’ and विलम्बित, ‘slow’); a pause in music; a parti-cular agricultural implement, (perhaps a sort of harrow or hoe, Ved.); (अम्), n. the root of Andropogon Muricatus; (अस्, आ, अम्), making the mind inactive or indifferent. —लय-काल, अस्, m. time of disso-lution or destruction. —लय-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone to dissolution, dissolved, melted. —लय-पुत्री, f. ‘daughter of (musical) time,’ a female dancer, actress. —लयारम्भ (°य-आर्°) or लयालम्ब (°य-आल्°), अस्, m. ‘moving according to time,’ a dancer, actor. —लयार्क (°य-अर्°), अस्, m. the sun at the dissolution of the world.
लरमानाथ: लरमानाथ लरमा-नाथ, अस्, m., N. of an author; [cf. रलमा-नाथ।]
लर्ब्: लर्ब् लर्ब्, cl. 1. P. लर्बति, &c., to go.
लल्: लल् लल् (= rt. लड्), cl. 1. P. A. ललति, ललते, &c., to play, sport, frolic, dally; to play (with the tongue); cl. 10. P. ललयति, &c., to loll the tongue, &c. (see rt. लड्): Caus. P. लाल-यति, &c. (according to some also ललयति), to cause to sport or dally; to caress, fondle, coax, cherish, nurse, love; A. लालयते, &c., to desire, &c.
लल: लल, अस्, आ, अम्, sporting, frolicking, playful; lolling, wagging; wishing, desirous. —लल-जिह्व = ललज्-जिह्व below.
ललत्: ललत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, playing, sporting, dallying; playing with the tongue, &c. —ललज्-जिह्व, अस्, आ, अम्, playing with the tongue, lolling the tongue, moving the tongue hither and thither; fierce, savage; (अस्), m. a camel; a dog. —ललद्-अम्बु, उस्, m. a particular plant (= लिम्पाक).
ललन: ललन, अस्, आ, अम्, playing, coruscating (said of light, colour, &c.); sporting; (अस्), m., N. of various plants, = साल, प्रियाल; (आ), f. a wanton woman; a woman (in general), a wife; the tongue; N. of several metres, four times ¯˘˘¯¯, ¯˘˘¯˘˘¯; four times ¯˘˘¯¯, ˘˘˘˘˘˘¯; a particular kind of Gāthā; N. of a mythical being; (अम्), n. play, sport, pleasure, dalliance; the playing or mov-ing to and fro of the tongue; lolling the tongue. —ललना-प्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, dear to women, liked by females; (अस्), m. Nauclea Cadamba; (अम्), n. = ह्री-वेर, a kind of drug. —ललना-वरूथिन्, ई, इनी, इ, surrounded by a troop of women.
ललनिका: ललनिका, f. a little woman, a miserable woman.

Sax. reaf, reafian: Old Norse rŷf: Lith. rup-e-ti, rup-u-s: Slav. lom-i-ti: Hib. reubaim, ‘I tear, lacerate;’ reuban, ‘plundering, robbery;’ lomaim, ‘I sheer, shave, make bare.’]

2. लुप्, falling or dropping out, suppression, elision, cutting off, rejection, (लुप् is one of the three tech-nical terms for grammatical elision classed with लुक्, q. v.; it is especially applicable to a Taddhita affix, implying its disappearance and preventing the ap-pearance of any other affix in its place.)
लुप्त: लुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, broken, violated, injured, destroyed; robbed, plundered, deprived of; omitted, left off, neglected; suppressed, cut off, elided (in grammar), rejected, fallen or dropped out, disap-peared, lost, obsolete, disused; (अम्), n. stolen pro-perty, plunder, booty. —लुप्त-ता, f. the state of being cut off or elided, disappearance, suppression, non-existence. —लुप्त-धर्म-क्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, excluded from or deprived of religious ordinances. —लुप्त-पद, अस्, आ, अम्, wanting (whole) words. —लुप्त-पिण्डोदक-क्रिय (°ड-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of funeral rites. —लुप्त-प्रतिभ, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of reason. —लुप्त-विसर्ग-ता, f. the dropping of Visarga. —लुप्तोपम (°त-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, wanting or failing in the particle of compa-rison; (आ), f. (in rhetoric) a mutilated or elliptical simile (the conjunction expressing comparison being omitted), a metaphor.
लुप्यमान: लुप्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being broken, being cut off, being perplexed or confused.
लोप: लोप, अस्, m. breaking, violation, fracture, mutila-tion, cutting off, destruction; robbing, plundering, stealing, deprivation, want, deficiency, loss, interrup-tion, intermission, omission, separation, disappear-ance, dropping or falling out, rejection, annulling, cancelling, erasure, grammatical elision, (लोप is the technical term for elision generally as distinguished from the terms लुप्, श्लु, लुक्, which are only appli-cable to affixes; when लोप of an affix takes place, a blank is substituted, which exerts the same influence on the base as the affix itself, but when either लुक् or लुप् or श्लु of an affix is enjoined, then the affix is not only dropped but it is also inoperative on the base; thus in the 1st pl. of कति, where जस् is said to be elided by लुक्, the change of the final of the base to Guṇa does not take place, i. e. both the affix and its effect on the base are abolished; moreover, लोप may refer only to the last letter of an affix, whereas by लुक् &c. the dropping of the whole affix is implied); (आ), f. = लोपामुद्रा. —लोपापत्ति (°प-आप्°), इस्, f. the being cut off or elided, the being dropped. —लोपामुद्रा (°प-अम्°), f., N. of the reputed wife of Agastya (regarded as the authoress of Ṛg-veda I. 179, 4). —लोपामुद्रा-पति, इस्, m. ‘husband of Lopāmudrā,’ N. of the sage Agastya.
लोप लोप, लोपन, लोप्तृ, &c. See p. 869, col. 3, and p. 870, col. 1.
लोपक: लोपक, अस्, इका, अम्, interrupting, annihilating, (धार-लोपक, अम्, n. [probably] epithet of a par-ticular ceremony); (अस्), m. violation.
लोपन: लोपन, अम्, n. the act of omitting or violating, violation; [cf. व्रत-ल्°।]
लोपाक: लोपाक, अस्, m. a kind of jackal.
लोपापक: लोपापक, अस्, m. a kind of jackal; (इका), f. the female of this jackal.
लोपाश: लोपाश, अस्, m. a jackal, fox, or a similar animal; [cf., according to some, Gr. ἀλώπηξ.]

लुब्ध: लुब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, desiring, covetous, greedy, avaricious; desirous of, longing for, (sometimes with loc., e. g. यशसि लुब्धः, desirous of fame); (अस्), m. a hunter; a lustful man, libertine. —लुब्ध-जन, अस्, आ, अम्, having covetous followers. —लुब्-ध-ता, f. or लुब्ध-त्व, अम्, n. greediness, ava-riciousness, covetousness, eager desire for.
लुभ्: लुभ् लुभ्, cl. 4. P. लुभ्यति, लुलोभ (A. लुलुभे), लोभिष्यति, अलुभत्, लो-भितुम्, लोब्धुम्, to desire greatly or eagerly, covet, long for anything (dat. or loc.); to be inter-ested in; to allure, (मां लुलुभे, he allured me); to be perplexed or disturbed, become disordered, go astray; cl. 6. P. लुभति, &c., Aor. अलोभीत्, to be-wilder, confound, perplex, disturb: Caus. लोभयति, &c., to cause to desire or long for, make greedy; ex-cite greediness or covetousness, excite lust; to allure, entice, entice away, seduce, attract; to disturb, de-range: Desid. लुलुभिषति, लुलोभिषति: Intens. लोलुभ्यते, लोलोब्धि; [cf. Gr. λίψ, λιψ-ουρία, λίπ-τ-ομαι, ἐλευθερός: Lat. lub-et, lib-et, lib-ī-do, lib-er, Libentina: Goth. liub-s, ‘dear;’ brothra-lub-o, us-laubjan: Old Germ. liub-an, môt-luba, lob, lob-ô-n: Angl. लौमि: लौमि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Loman.
लौलाह: लौलाह लौलाह, N. of a place.

(fr. लोल), restlessness, instability, inconstancy, fickleness; lustfulness, eager-ness, eager desire, greediness, passion, (अ-लौल्य, अम्, n. absence of all desire.) —लौल्य-ता, f. lustful-ness, eager desire. —लौल्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, eagerly desirous, eager, greedy, avaricious, lustful.
लौश: लौश लौश, अम्, n. (fr. लुश), N. of various Sāmans.

लौहायन: लौहायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Loha.
लौहायस: लौहायस, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. लोहायस), made of metal, metallic, made of copper, &c.
लौहि: लौहि लौहि, इस्, m., N. of a son of Aṣṭaka.
लौहित: लौहित लौहित, अस्, m. (fr. 1. लोहित), the trident of Śiva.
लौहितध्वज: लौहितध्वज, अस्, m. (fr. लोहित-ध्वज), a follower of the Lohita-dhvajas.
लौहितीक: लौहितीक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 1. लोहित), reddish, hav-ing a reddish lustre.
लौहित्य: लौहित्य, अस्, m. (fr. 1. लोहित), a patronymic; N. of a river, the Brahma-putra; of a sea; of a mountain; of a Tīrtha, (in this sense probably अम्, n.); (अम्), n. red colour, redness.
लौहित्यायनी: लौहित्यायनी, f. (feminine form of the above), a patronymic.
